title: The ex vivo human translaminar autonomous system to study spaceflight associated neuro-ocular syndrome pathogenesis (Optic Nerve, Histology and Microscopy)
organism: Homo sapiens (ex vivo optic nerve tissue)
assays: Molecular Cellular Imaging (IHC, TUNEL apoptosis assay)

protocols.experimental_factors: 10 to 12-day sustained elevated translaminar pressure gradient (15:16 mmHg)
protocols.measurements: Normal vs abnormal optic nerve axon density counts

diagnostic_explanation: Prolonged translaminar pressure imbalance causes optic disc edema and axoplasmic flow stasis, resulting in hyperopic visual acuity shifts.
